# SKILLS.md — AI Skills for Humanities & Academic Research

> Markdown skills for academic research, Bardin's Content Analysis, and literature review. Each skill is a folder containing a `SKILL.md` file (YAML frontmatter + Markdown body).

Repository: https://github.com/14NGiestas/SKILLS.md
Website: https://14ngiestas.github.io/SKILLS.md/
English README: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/14NGiestas/SKILLS.md/main/README.md
Portuguese README: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/14NGiestas/SKILLS.md/main/README.pt-br.md
English catalog: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/14NGiestas/SKILLS.md/main/en/README.md
Portuguese catalog: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/14NGiestas/SKILLS.md/main/pt-br/README.md
Full file tree: https://api.github.com/repos/14NGiestas/SKILLS.md/git/trees/main?recursive=1

## English

- [bardin-pre-analysis](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/14NGiestas/SKILLS.md/main/en/content-analysis-bardin/bardin-pre-analysis/SKILL.md): Use when planning the corpus for Bardin's content analysis: floating reading, the 4 corpus rules (exhaustiveness, representativeness, homogeneity, relevance), and formalizing hypotheses, objectives, and reading indices. Phase 1 of Bardin (2011/2016).
- [bardin-coding](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/14NGiestas/SKILLS.md/main/en/content-analysis-bardin/bardin-coding/SKILL.md): Use when coding a corpus in Bardin's content analysis: cut Recording Units (RU) and Context Units (CU), set enumeration/counting rules, and extract coded textual evidence. Step 4 of Phase 2 (Bardin, 2011/2016).
- [bardin-categorization](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/14NGiestas/SKILLS.md/main/en/content-analysis-bardin/bardin-categorization/SKILL.md): Use when grouping coded units into categories in Bardin's content analysis: build categories and subcategories, audit the 5 formal criteria (mutual exclusion, homogeneity, relevance, objectivity/fidelity, productivity), write the category dictionary, and produce the traceability matrix.
- [bardin-interpretation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/14NGiestas/SKILLS.md/main/en/content-analysis-bardin/bardin-interpretation/SKILL.md): Use when interpreting and defending Bardin's content analysis: move from manifest to latent content, triangulate findings with theory, draft the results/discussion, and simulate examination-board questions. Phase 3 (Bardin, 2011/2016).
- [annotated-bibliography](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/14NGiestas/SKILLS.md/main/en/literature-review/annotated-bibliography/SKILL.md): Use when writing reading notes or an annotated bibliography for articles, book chapters, theses, or dissertations: extract the central thesis, objectives, key concepts, verbatim quotes with page numbers, and critical appraisal (APA/Chicago).

## Portuguese

- [bardin-pre-analise](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/14NGiestas/SKILLS.md/main/pt-br/analise-de-conteudo-bardin/bardin-pre-analise/SKILL.md): Use quando for planejar o corpus da Análise de Conteúdo de Bardin: leitura flutuante, as 4 regras do corpus (exaustividade, representatividade, homogeneidade, pertinência) e formalização de hipóteses, objetivos e índices de leitura. Fase 1 de Bardin (2011/2016).
- [bardin-codificacao](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/14NGiestas/SKILLS.md/main/pt-br/analise-de-conteudo-bardin/bardin-codificacao/SKILL.md): Use quando for codificar o corpus na Análise de Conteúdo de Bardin: recortar Unidades de Registro (UR) e Unidades de Contexto (UC), definir regras de enumeração/contagem e extrair evidências textuais codificadas. Passo 4 da Fase 2 (Bardin, 2011/2016).
- [bardin-categorizacao](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/14NGiestas/SKILLS.md/main/pt-br/analise-de-conteudo-bardin/bardin-categorizacao/SKILL.md): Use quando for agrupar unidades codificadas em categorias na Análise de Conteúdo de Bardin: construir categorias e subcategorias, auditar os 5 critérios formais (exclusão mútua, homogeneidade, pertinência, objetividade/fidelidade, produtividade), elaborar o dicionário categorial e gerar a matriz de rastreabilidade.
- [bardin-interpretacao](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/14NGiestas/SKILLS.md/main/pt-br/analise-de-conteudo-bardin/bardin-interpretacao/SKILL.md): Use quando for interpretar e defender a Análise de Conteúdo de Bardin: passar do conteúdo manifesto ao latente, triangular os achados com a teoria, redigir resultados/discussão e simular perguntas de banca. Fase 3 (Bardin, 2011/2016).
- [fichamento-academico](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/14NGiestas/SKILLS.md/main/pt-br/revisao-bibliografica/fichamento-academico/SKILL.md): Use quando for fazer fichamento ou bibliografia anotada de artigos, capítulos, teses ou dissertações: extrair tese central, objetivos, conceitos-chave, citações diretas com páginas e apreciação crítica (ABNT/APA).
- [abnt-referencias](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/14NGiestas/SKILLS.md/main/pt-br/revisao-bibliografica/abnt-referencias/SKILL.md): Use quando for montar, revisar ou conferir referências de trabalhos acadêmicos segundo a ABNT NBR 6023:2025: livros, capítulos, artigos, teses, eventos, documentos jurídicos, mídias e fontes online. Cobre autoria, ordem dos elementos, pontuação, DOI, URL e data de acesso.
